test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average age of 20 students of a class is 29 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 30 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
**Given:**

Average age of 20 students = 29 years

Average age of group including teacher = 30 years

Number of students = 20

Number of people in group including teacher = 21

**Formula Used:**

Total age = Average × Number of people

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of 20 students = 29 × 20

⇒ Total age of 20 students = 580

⇒ Total age of group including teacher = 30 × 21

⇒ Total age of group including teacher = 630

⇒ Age of teacher = Total age of group including teacher − Total age of 20 students

⇒ Age of teacher = 630 − 580

⇒ Age of teacher = 50

**∴ The correct answer is 50.**
